players.aimNote: One hit per fired shot, including pellets and penetrations. Head hit share excludes AWP. Bursts: same weapon/round with gaps ≤300 ms; sprays require 3+ rifle shots. No visibility filter. — means no samples; these definitions can differ from other platforms.
players.barNote: Bars: percentages use 100%; ADR, damage and shots use the match maximum.
players.duelsNote: Row player kills column player. Percentage = kills / (kills + reverse kills). Enemy encounters only; — means no duel or same team.
players.clutchesNote: Starts when the player is the last teammate alive against at least one enemy. Survival is measured at round end; it does not imply an intentional save. Success includes all attempts.
players.tradesNote: A teammate kills your killer within 5 seconds, in the same round. Counts successful trades only; no visibility-based opportunities or attempts.
players.utilityNote: Throws count weapon_fire events. Blinds longer than 1 s count only for living targets; teammates include yourself. Blind time sums qualifying enemy durations, including overlaps. Flash assists use the death event flag. — means no throws.
players.activityNote: Enemy damage excludes overkill and friendly fire. Survival is measured through the official round end.
players.generalNote: KAST: kill, assist, survival or death traded within 5 seconds. Multi-kills: 2k / 3k / 4k / 5k rounds.
players.openingNote: First enemy kill in each round. Participation = (opening kills + opening deaths) / rounds played.
players.flashNote: Flash assists are included in assists

charts.timelineHint: The strip shows round winners; ★ marks highlights. Hover or focus for round details. Click a legend to hide a player.
charts.cashHint: Team cash immediately after freeze end, excluding equipment value. Missing samples are omitted.
charts.differenceHint: Team A wins minus Team B wins.
charts.cumulativeHint: Cumulative through each round; flashed counts enemy blind events over 1.1 seconds.

settings.toolsIncomplete: Tools are not fully installed. Some features will be limited.
settings.clearToAuto: Clear and go back to auto-detect
settings.clearParsedConfirm: Deletes saved analysis; demos without errors are parsed again automatically. Failed demos still require a manual retry. Demo files and videos are kept.
settings.clearClipsConfirm: Deletes every exported video and job record; demo files and parsed data are kept.
settings.clearRadarConfirm: Extracted again from the game files the next time the 2D replay opens.
settings.dataDirHint: Select the data folder itself. Clear to use the default data directory. Changes apply after restarting; existing files are not moved.
settings.restartRequired: Restart the app to use the selected data directory. Storage actions below still use the current directory.
settings.autoParseHint: New demos in these folders are parsed automatically. Failed demos can be retried manually.

ui.queueHint: Current jobs and clips. Open a demo to view its details.

recoil.noReference: No paired firing-angle samples; reference unavailable.
recoil.title: Single-match spray movement
recoil.vertical: Y° · up + / down −. All weapons share the same scale.
recoil.definition: Fresh recoil index (≈0), at least 3 consecutive shots, gaps ≤300 ms with index increasing by 1. Missing samples break the burst. Each point averages only bursts reaching that shot; later points have fewer samples.
